subject.title: feat(ios): replace the tab bar with a black overlay sidebar (web parity + dashboard)

question: After the completeness fixes, should OpenClaw permanently replace the iPhone tab-bar/Control-hub model with this sidebar-only shell?
rationale: This is a broad, user-visible navigation and information-architecture decision rather than a mechanically determined bug fix; the existing maintainer label requires an explicit owner decision.

options.title: Adopt the sidebar shell
options.body: Approve the permanent sidebar-only direction after pagination/completeness repairs and focused iPhone regression proof.

options.title: Preserve a phone-specific root path
options.body: Keep a tab or Control-hub affordance if one-handed phone navigation needs a distinct product model from iPad and web.

recommendation.title: Adopt the sidebar shell
recommendation.body: Approve the permanent sidebar-only direction after pagination/completeness repairs and focused iPhone regression proof.

likelyOwner.reason: The available history ties this person to both the proposed iOS implementation and the related navigation-direction work.
